title: Fox News viewers mock Nicki Minaj as she says Democrats are 'too caught up in pop culture' - NewsBreak
text:
By Kathleen O'Boyle ,
7 hours ago Nicki Minaj is facing a wave of reactions after criticizing Democrats for becoming too closely tied to the entertainment world during an appearance on Fox News.
The rapper appeared on My View with Lara Trump on September 26, where she spoke with Lara Trump about politics and her decision to identify with the Republican Party ahead of the midterm elections. The interview came as Nicki has become increasingly vocal about her support for President Donald Trump and his administration.
Nicki was asked by Lara, the president’s daughter-in-law, “what she saw in the Democrats that led her to believe being a Republican was a better choice for her.” The visit came as fans dragged her online for a 'Republican' makeover.
• Johnny Depp takes bite of plant backdrop at Las Vegas event as he raises toast
• Prince William makes secret visit without Princess Kate amid Diana memoir scandal
“Well, I think the Democrats have gotten way too caught up in pop culture, for lack of a better term,” Nicki responded. “I think they’ve allowed their relationships with artists to cause them to act like children, and to be so petty and childish.”
The comment quickly drew attention online, with some social media users pointing out that Nicki herself is one of the biggest names in pop culture.
“Fox News: Hey Nicki Minaj, please come on our broadcast so we can leech the black vote off of you since you’re such a huge pop culture icon. It’s crazy that there are living people who take Fox seriously,” one person said.
Another wrote, “Nicki’s butt fillers literally are pop culture.”
““The Democrats have gotten so caught up in Pop Culture, they’re acting so petty and childish,” meanwhile, I’m going to pretend that Trump hasn’t been broadcasting videos made with pop culture references and clips from movies, TV, and video games while launching an Arcade Game,” someone else added.
A fourth said, “I don’t get why we are supposed to care what Nicki Minaj thinks?!” “I just remembered why I stopped watching Fox a year ago,” a fifth wrote.
Nicki has made her support for Trump increasingly known over the past year. The rapper made a surprise appearance at Turning Point USA’s AmericaFest in December 2025, where she praised Trump and Vice President JD Vance and described them as role models for young men. The appearance marked a notable shift from Nicki's earlier criticism of Trump, particularly over his immigration policies.
She has continued to publicly back Trump throughout 2026. In January, Nicki appeared alongside Trump at the Treasury Department’s Trump Accounts Summit in Washington, D.C., where she called herself the president’s “number one fan.” She also said that criticism of Trump only motivated her to support him more.
At the summit, Nicki pledged between $150,000 and $300,000 toward Trump Accounts, a program that provides eligible children with federally seeded investment accounts. She joined Trump onstage during the event, further highlighting her increasingly visible relationship with the administration.
Nicki also visited the White House in July for a Rose Garden luncheon, where Trump publicly praised her. Her appearances with the president and other Trump allies have made her political shift a regular subject of discussion, particularly among fans who remember her previous criticism of the Republican leader.
